name: Scarlett University
source:
Scarlett University takes you on an erotic, high-stakes journey as a wide-eyed freshman steps into the world of elite sexual refinement. Enrolling in secret, she quickly progresses into the university sex simulation program where she finds herself well out of her depth, but buckled in for the wild ride she spent her teenage years fantasizing about. An unexpected malfunction in the advanced simulation device exposes hidden ulterior motives lurking beneath the glossy campus façade. She'll need the support of her exciting new friends to make it to graduation without losing herself to the darkest corners of desire.
